why: D-417 -- A MOB MAY NOT MOVE ITSELF. Dan reported mobs walking through blocks; the cause was `Ai.stepToward` writing `e.x`/`e.y`/`e.z` outright, so no mob had ever been through `Ph.move` and no collision test could ever have caught it. This is the CLASS stated as a rule -- after a tick, no living entity's box may overlap a full cube -- plus the move control, the travel law, the jump, `Entity.push` and suffocation.
